start=124738681; end=124738772
counts=collections.Counter(); samples={}

    best=None; bestlen=0; details=[]
    with gzip.open(f,'rt') as fh:
        for line in fh:
            if not line.startswith('chr11\\t'): continue
            p=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
            s=int(p[1]); e=int(p[2]); state=p[3]
            if e<=start or s>=end: continue

print('\\nstate categories summary')
# print by mnemonic category
for state,n in counts.most_common():
    print(state,n)
print('\\nSample details around region:')
